The reality of complex projects

Engineering projects drown
in information chaos.

Despite €100B+ invested annually in infrastructure, project teams still operate through scattered Excel sheets, deeply nested PDFs and disconnected email threads. Information lives in silos. Decisions wait. Costs grow.

📧
Information buried in chaos
200+ emails per day. 50+ drawing revisions. Critical information scattered across Excel, PDFs, shared drives, chat threads — no single source of truth.

PROBLEM 02
📊
Zero visibility for managers
Status reports are stitched together manually every week. By the time the dashboard reaches leadership, the data is already stale and decisions are reactive.
▸ 6+ hours/week wasted on report assembly
PROBLEM 03
⚙️
Disconnected engineering
Engineers, contractors and operators work in different tools, different formats, different revisions. Coordination meetings exist only to align what should have been already obvious.
▸ 30% of issues caused by miscommunication

CAPABILITY 01

Manage projects visually in 3D.

A project is not a spreadsheet — it is a physical system. ENGINIQ lets you navigate your project the way it exists in reality — spatially, contextually, intuitively.

  • Click any component to instantly see its full engineering context — drawings, status, history.
  • Spatial search replaces text search. Find what you need by where it is, not by how it's named.
  • Onboard non-technical stakeholders instantly — investors, regulators, board members understand 3D.

CAPABILITY 05

Support maintenance and commissioning workflows.

From handover to end-of-life — track service intervals, manage spares, schedule inspections. The same digital twin that built the plant operates it.

  • Service interval tracking — running hours, calendar-based, condition-based maintenance per component.
  • Spare parts catalogue — linked to each component with stock levels, suppliers, lead times.
  • Commissioning checklists — pre-commissioning, functional tests, performance verification — sign-offs by role.

CAPABILITY 06

Coordinate teams across the consortium.

A typical infrastructure project involves 30+ stakeholders across multiple companies. ENGINIQ unifies them around one source of truth.

  • Multi-user, real-time — engineers, managers, contractors, operators work in the same model simultaneously.
  • Role-based access — OEMs see only their components, operators see all assets, executives see KPIs.
  • Context-aware messaging — comments tied to components. Discussions stay attached where decisions need to be made.

Engineering depth, not software theater.

ENGINIQ is built by a senior engineer with 10+ years of experience leading complex industrial projects — currently managing a €200M+ hydroelectric revitalization in a multi-country EU consortium with OEMs, EPC contractors and operators. Every feature in the platform exists because the founder personally needed it.

TECHNICAL DOMAIN
Hydromechanical equipment, generators, excitation and protection systems, SCADA, commissioning workflows. Real exposure to the entire lifecycle — from contract negotiation to FAT/SAT to plant handover.
PROJECT EXPERIENCE
Coordinated 30+ stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions — engineering reviewers, OEM project managers, financial auditors, regulatory authorities. Every complexity in the demos is a problem I lived through, and solved.
AI & AUTOMATION
Two years of intensive work with AI in engineering contexts — from report automation to interactive digital twins like the ones you've seen here. Built entirely in-house. No third-party developers. No SaaS resell.
